Exit-efficiency pools variants — the same fire appears under each management, so rows are management-outcomes, not independent fires (stated). Prices are the FUTURES leg (the journal's basis). NET LEDGER = per-cell pooled net with MANDATORY zone decomposition (descriptive, no null; ranking is best-of-field by construction): pooled INCLUDES the lockbox span under the dated operator order of 2026-08-27 — the one sanctioned decomposition display; register 85 stands for every evidential aggregate, and the decomposition columns are why the pooled number is candidate-generation only.
